Subject: Discovery follow-up & next steps — demo scheduling

Hi Alex / Morgan,

Thanks again for the time today — really appreciate the context on FinPath's ingestion pipelines and the strict latency and audit requirements. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: primary goal is to add a contextual search + summarize feature into the existing claims workflow. Critical constraints: PII redaction at ingest, EU data residency for some customer subsets, and a 200ms p95 latency target for short responses.
- Next steps we recommend: 1) Product demo (business-facing) to show expected UX and cost implications; 2) Technical deep-dive with our SE to discuss architecture, KV cache strategy, and network topology; 3) Security/procurement sync for SOC2 artifacts and contracting timeline.

Proposed demo slots (PDT):
- Mon Aug 2 • 10:00–11:00am
- Tue Aug 3 • 9:00–10:00am
- Tue Aug 3 • 4:00–5:00pm

Can you confirm which of these works for the core team? If none, share a couple of alternatives and we’ll align calendars. I’ll loop in our SE and Security/Procurement to make sure the right people can attend the technical session.

I’ve attached a draft SOW and our SOC2 evidence request template for your security team to review (stubs attached below).

Attachments: FinPath-SOW-draft.pdf (doc), SOC2-evidence-request.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks — looking forward to the next step.

—

Looping you all in — FinPath confirmed Tue Aug 3 • 9:00–10:00am PDT for the product demo and would like a technical deep-dive the same week. Alex asked for an SE agenda and SOC2 artifacts ahead of the security call. Jordan Blake (procurement) will be on the procurement thread from FinPath.

Nikhil — can you take point on the technical deep-dive? Suggested agenda: 1) brief infra overview (20m), 2) KV cache & prefix caching strategy (20m), 3) latency profiling & ops playbook (15m), 4) Q&A (5–10m). Please include any infra diagrams or perf profiles you want to share as pre-read.

Rachel — FinPath flagged EU residency requirements and wants to see what SOC2 artifacts we can provide/what we can redact. I attached the SOC2 evidence request template — can you confirm what we can supply before the call and what will require an NDA/procurement intake?

Priyom — Jordan will be the procurement lead from FinPath. Can you propose a high-level contracting timeline (SOW -> legal review -> signature) and whether we need to route this through our reseller or handle direct?

I’ve added a calendar provisional here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=finpath-demo-aug3 and uploaded pre-read assets: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/finpath-pre-read

Thanks all — would like to lock the calendar and get pre-reads out by end of week.

—
Marissa
